nodes.label: Sensors & Orientation Subsystem
nodes.description: Accelerometer, magnetic field compass, pitch/roll level calculations, and auto-stabilization alignment.

nodes.label: UI Overlays & Composition Guides
nodes.description: Live histogram display, zebra stripes highlight clipping, focus peaking, composition grids (golden ratio, 3x3), and camera HUD controls.

nodes.label: OpenKamera Architecture
nodes.description: Modernized Kotlin camera application for Android based on Open Camera v1.56.2, prioritizing privacy and manual hardware control.
nodes.rationale: Ported Java codebase to idiomatic Kotlin targeting modern Android APIs (Target SDK 36, Camera2 API).

nodes.label: Image Processing & HDR/DRO
nodes.description: Multi-frame computational photography, HDR exposure blending, Dynamic Range Optimization (DRO), focus bracketing, and noise reduction.

nodes.label: Audio Trigger & Remote Controls
nodes.description: Noise level / audio trigger (whistle/shout), timer, and Bluetooth LE remote shutter integration.

nodes.label: Preview & Surface Pipeline
nodes.description: Preview surface management, rendering pipeline, aspect ratio calculation, and camera preview lifecycle.

nodes.label: Storage & SAF Subsystem
nodes.description: Storage Access Framework (SAF) integration, background ImageSaver queue, Exif metadata handling, and media store scanning.

nodes.label: Camera Controller Layer
nodes.description: Unified abstraction layer supporting both legacy Camera1 and modern Camera2 APIs with manual controls for ISO, shutter, focus, and RAW/DNG capture.
